name: Son or Husband
source: If you act the part of my wife for a month, I'll give you $500,000. What do you think?" Christian is the perfect fake husband, Evan his irresistible son. When you're caught in the tug of war between the two men, who will you choose?
translation: “如果你扮演我妻子一个月，我就给你五十万美元。你觉得怎么样？”克里斯蒂安是完美的假丈夫，埃文是他令人无法抗拒的儿子。当你陷入两个男人的拉锯战时，你会选择谁？
